article.story: SMITHFIELD, R.I. -- — Barry Evans had 24 points in Bryant's 85-62 victory against UMass-Lowell on Saturday night. Evans also contributed five rebounds for the Bulldogs (10-9, 4-0 America East Conference). Rafael Pinzon scored 16 points, shooting 7 for 16, including 2 for 8 from beyond the arc. Connor Withers had 15 points and shot 5 for 13, including 5 for 11 from beyond the arc. Max Brooks led the River Hawks (13-6, 2-2) in scoring, finishing with 12 points and eight rebounds. UMass-Lowell also got 12 points from Yuri Covington. Martin Somerville had 11 points, four assists and three steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
